answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil swarms by making each new identity post a small refundable bond that stays locked for a probation voyage of several weeks. During that time the agent must finish real tasks that randomly chosen peers check. Like a pearl, trust forms slowly in layers; a farm of fresh accounts flagged violet on the dashboard earns little until its bonds and verified work history mature, so faking thousands of names becomes too costly to pay off.
